audit_name: Vermont initial filing code availability audit
scope: Initial case catalog options only; per enabled court, inspect Family RFA case types and exact Initial Filing option; inspect Small Claims case types where offered. No legal coverage or interview-completeness assertion.

method.court_selection: Fetched CodeCatalog court list (fileable_only=false, with_names=true), then retained Vermont court_selector options: names ending in Unit, Environmental Division, Supreme Court, Judicial Bureau.
method.matching_rule: Exact, case-sensitive filing type name “Initial Filing”; code and name are retained as returned by the provider (deduplicated by code as CodeCatalog does).
limits: This is a catalog retrieval test, not a legal coverage assertion.
The API response does not expose a catalog version. Each recorded response Date header is included.
Only exact Initial Filing labels are counted; Initial Filing - Confidential is not treated as a match.
